name: Star Jumps
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Bend your knees slightly to prepare for the jump.
Explosively jump up as high as possible.
As you jump, spread your arms and legs out wide to form a star shape in the air.
Fully extend your limbs at the peak of the jump.
Bring your arms and legs back together as you descend.
Land softly with knees bent to absorb the impact.
Immediately prepare for the next repetition.
